name: Denied tool calls
what: A rule can deny a tool call by its exact text, and it says as its worst case that the same action written another way does not match. The model sees its own call, unchanged, with an error that says it was denied, and the record keeps every change Silo made to the traffic. The agent's next call is judged on its own.

suggest.why: A few commands are worth denying before they run, by a rule the agent cannot remove and with a refusal the model understands.
